assertions.statement: A delivery is created idempotently from its tenant-scoped business key.
One order can own multiple packages and one package can bind multiple devices without duplicate relations.
Mismatched tenant order item assignment or device relationships are rejected atomically.
Identical full tracking snapshots do not create a new effective version or increment trackingVersion.
Late tracking data cannot regress a terminal delivery state.
Outbox and Inbox persistence are tenant-scoped and deduplicate stable keys without storing plaintext PII or secrets in Outbox payloads.
Sensitive logistics and provider configuration fields use the project encryption type handler and are excluded from string output.
The provider abstraction contains no Kuaidi100 SDK type and ordinary tests perform no real provider network request.
The additive migration succeeds for a fresh schema and for an upgrade from migration 031 without changing existing business values.
This change adds no logistics HTTP endpoint worker provider adapter Xianyu shipment integration schedule-center UI or automatic device-availability transition.
